Field projection: sum(Collection[R], :field) -> F where F is the field's type; non-Symbol or missing field -> OOF-COL5. Arity not in {1,2} -> OOF-COL1; non-Collection first arg -> OOF-COL2. No implicit numeric coercion. VM: scalar form sums elements directly; the empty Decimal collection yields Integer 0 at runtime (the universal additive zero, consistent with the field form) — only observable on empty collections.
